page.layout: One printed page (left-hand text block of a book photographed at an angle, with the binding edge at right). Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Main text in one column of roman type with a few Greek lines of verse and a centred italic line, then a short Latin verse set as lines, ending with a catchword-like half line "Exigui" at lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: em : etenim si aliquis sit arrogans & insolescat in
amplitudine regni sui, atque adeo sit Monarcha,
exempli gratia, totius Europæ fingamus eum
aliquo genio ad globum usque Lunæ eleuari,
& inde suum istud tam amplum regnum intueri,
videbitur sane illi minus totum istud regnum,
quam paruus aliquis pagus ; imo ne pagus qui-
dem videbitur, nec domuncula, aut casula,
siquidem inde, nempe à globo lunæ, totam
terram non conspiciet maiorem, quam hinc conspicit
Lunam triplicatam. Atque hoc est quod Sene-
ca monere voluit lib. 1. quæst. natural. Hoc,
inquit, terræ punctulum diuiditur inter mortales
ferro & armis, quasi diceret: merito ad humilitatem
mortales sese cohortari debere, dum sc-
ilicet considerant omnia regna, & de quibus bell-
agerunt, nihil aliud esse quam punctum quod
diuidi non possit. Et Plinius lib. 2. c.
68. præclaram de eadem re admonitionem habet, quam studio-
si priuatim perlegent. Facit ad hanc rem etiam
præclarum illud Epigramma Palladæ:
Εἰ τὶς ποτέν συμετρεῖς κόσμον τῇ πείρᾳ τῆς γῆς
Ἐξ ὀλίγης γαίης σῶμα φέρων ὀλίγον:
Σαυτὸν ἀριθμήσον ως ἔσται τῷ γνῶσι σεαυτὸν,
Καὶ τότ' ἀριθμήσεις γαῖαν ἀπειρέσιον.
Εἰ δ' ὀλίγον σπλὸν τῆς σώματος ἡ ἀριθμεῖσθαι,
Πῶς δύνασαι γνῶναι τῶν ἀμιέδων τε μέτρα.
Hoc est.
Cur numeras fines terræ, metiris & astra
Qui paruum è tenui puluere corpus habes:
Te numeres primum qui fis, tua membra viaeto,
Hinc fines terræ dinumerare potes.
Exigui

page.notes: Greek verse lines and the italic line "Hoc est." are transcribed from a small, slanted scan; Greek accents are approximate and marked as doubtful where unclear. The Latin distich lines at the end are partly unclear (e.g. "viaeto"). Several words in the main column near the binding are uncertain.
